name: xTool D1 Pro
notes: Open-frame diode laser with swappable modules.
source: xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension MDP (exts/D1Pro), read 2026-11-26. Work areas from the extension's processingArea table for LASER_PLANE with red-cross positioning (the 2 W module uses red-dot positioning); low-light positioning allows a few mm more width. The extension only gives watts (power enum 0/2/5/10/20/40); that 2 W is the 1064 nm infrared module and the others are blue diodes is xTool's module line-up, not stated in the extension. Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
